title: Neurosymbolic 80M AI from Princeton beats GPT
summary: Discover AI walkthrough of an 80M-parameter neurosymbolic Princeton model claiming to beat GPT-5-class systems on tasks where domain-specific knowledge graphs + professional-grade ontology rules govern reasoning. Graph-mer-style architecture learns semantic relation embeddings adhering to ontology rules, vs pattern-matching over surface-level word correlations. Argues path forward for super-intelligence is neurosymbolic with domain knowledge graphs — no NVIDIA-scale infrastructure needed.
claims: 80M-parameter neurosymbolic Princeton model claims to beat GPT-5-class systems on graph-aware tasks
Domain-specific knowledge graphs + professional-grade ontology rules govern reasoning, not training-corpus correlations
Graph-mer architecture learns semantic relation embeddings constrained by ontology rules
Doesn't need NVIDIA-scale compute infrastructure for the domain-specific case
Future direction: neurosymbolic AI with domain knowledge graphs as the path to super-intelligence (vs pure-LLM scaling)
